title: 第1章 被逐出宗门第2章 捡了一把剑
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
今天是云星落被逐出宗门的日子。
就很离谱。
罪名竟然是她偷看师尊沐浴。
她偷看过吗？
当然没有，不过倒是偷看了师尊和小师妹双修。
刺激吧？
一年前师尊从外面带回来一名妙龄少女，她成了他们天剑宗云海峰的小师妹。
小师妹天生眉骨，娇软可人，腰间的一朵梅花印记，情动时能绚丽绽放，摄人心魄。
师尊被她迷住，不到一年他们就滚到了一起。
师尊睡弟子，如此乱伦之事，一旦被人知道，天剑宗必将沦为整个修真界的笑柄，凌虚道人更是会被千夫所指。
偏偏还被云星落这个倒霉蛋看到了。
云星落要么滚要么死。
凌虚道人一脸威严，道貌岸然地端坐在堂上，骇然的目光瞪着堂下的云星落。
“孽徒，你可知罪？”
云星落跪在冰冷坚硬的地板上，凌虚道人那恐怖的威压像一座大山，压得她直不起腰来。
她心中满是愤怒与不甘，艰难地抬起头，狠狠啐了一口。
一个两千岁的干瘪老头，脸上的褶子就算蚊子来了都得崴脚，萝卜干都比他水灵，她是有什么癖好吗去偷看她沐浴？
她就是偷看杂役区的小哥哥，偷看烧火房的伙夫，都不会偷看这老屁登一眼好吗？
云星落傲骨铮铮，打死也不承认这莫须有的罪名。
可他娘的这破嘴，不知道被那狗师尊施了什么妖法，开口说出的话言不由衷。

“弟子知罪，弟子道德败坏，不知羞耻，偷看师尊沐浴，弟子愿意接受惩罚。”
话落，台下的三位师兄都用鄙夷的眼神看着她。
三师兄童朔撇了撇嘴，满脸嫌隙，“想不到四师妹平时一本正经，竟然是这等心思龌龊之人，真是让人不齿。”
二师兄徐默也跟着附和，“就是，平日里装得清高无比，背地里却干出这种勾当，简直败坏门风！”
大师兄肖鹤一脸严肃，“师尊，既然四师妹承认了，就罚她到玄冰潭去思过三年吧。”
闻言，云星落内心一沉，如坠冰窟。
众所周知，玄冰潭温度极低，没结丹的修士进去，最多只能待一个月，再久经脉就会慢慢冻结，最后彻底变成废人。
现在让她待三年，无异于要她的命。
也对，他们所有人都巴不得她死。
因为三个师兄也和师尊一样，早就被苏芫芫迷得神魂颠倒。
自师尊和苏芫芫双修之后，师尊容光焕发，足足年轻了几百岁。
而他的修为，也从化神境突破到了入圣境，三名师兄嫉妒得眼都红了。
这样只靠双修就能让人修为暴涨的人间尤物，谁不爱呢？
content_en:
Today is the day that Yun Xingluo was expelled from the sect.
Just outrageous.
The crime turned out to be that she peeped at Master bathing.
Has she peeked?
Of course not, but I did take a peek at the master and junior sister practicing together.
Exciting, right?
A year ago, Master brought back a young girl from outside, and she became the junior sister of Yun Haifeng, their Heavenly Sword Sect.
The little junior sister is born with eyebrows that are soft and lovely. The mark of a plum blossom on her waist can bloom brilliantly when she is emotional, which is breathtaking.
The master was fascinated by her, and within a year they were together.
Master sleeping with his disciple, once such incest is known, Tianjian Sect will definitely become the laughing stock of the entire cultivation world, and Taoist Lingxu will be criticized by thousands of people.
It happened that the unlucky guy Yun Xingluo saw it.
Yun Xingluo must roll or die.
Taoist Lingxu looked majestic and sanctimonious as he sat in the hall, glaring at Yun Xingluo down the hall with horrified eyes.
"Evil disciple, do you know your sin?"
Yun Xingluo knelt on the cold and hard floor. Taoist Lingxu's terrifying pressure was like a mountain, making her unable to straighten her back.
Full of anger and unwillingness, she raised her head with difficulty and spat hard.
A wizened old man of two thousand years old, with wrinkles on his face that would make his feet wet even when mosquitoes come, and dried radishes that are more juicy than him. What kind of hobby does she have to spy on her bathing?
Even if she peeks at the little brother in the handyman area or the cook in the fire room, she won't peek at this old fart, okay?
Yun Xingluo was so proud that he would not admit to this unfounded crime even if he was killed.
But he has such a bad mouth. I don’t know what kind of evil spell was cast on him by that dog master, and the words he spoke were not sincere.
"I know my crime. I am morally corrupt and shameless. I peeped at Master bathing. I am willing to accept the punishment."
After she finished speaking, the three senior brothers in the audience looked at her with contempt.
Third Senior Brother Tong Shuo curled his lips with a look of disgust on his face, "I didn't expect that Fourth Junior Sister, who is usually so serious, would turn out to be such a dirty-minded person. It's really disgusting."
Second senior brother Xu Mo also echoed, "That's right, if you pretend to be extremely aloof on weekdays, but you do this kind of thing behind your back, it's really ruining the family tradition!"
Senior brother Xiao He looked serious, "Master, since the fourth junior sister admits it, let's punish her to go to Xuanbingtan for three years to think about it."
Hearing this, Yun Xingluo's heart sank, like falling into an ice cave.
As we all know, the temperature of Xuanbingtan is extremely low. A monk who has not formed an elixir can only stay there for a month at most. Any longer, and his meridians will slowly freeze, and he will eventually become a complete invalid.
Letting her stay for three years now is tantamount to killing her.
That's right, all of them wanted her to die.
Because the three senior brothers, like their master, had long been fascinated by Su Xiangqian.
Since Master and Su Xiangqian practiced cultivation together, Master has become radiant and has become hundreds of years younger.
And his cultivation level also broke through from the Divine Realm to the Saint Realm, and the three senior brothers were so jealous that their eyes turned red.
Who wouldn't love this beauty in the world who can make people's cultivation skyrocket just by practicing dual cultivation?
